_doc: Engine forms of the Effects named Effects that items and techniques carry (design/items/catalogue-*.json, effects.md). fight.py adds an Effect's records when a build wears a piece naming it and the build file has not written its own 'eff:<Name>' records (a build's own version wins). Each entry: rule (the text it implements), records (engine Effects), optional static (lines folded into the build like item modifiers), reserve (share of linh luc reserved), count (compile-time multiplier: equipped items by role or by an art tag), approx (where the engine form is close but not exact), not_run (the rule needs a system the sim does not have). Units: dmg_more and cost_red are shares (0.15 = 15 %), L1-L5, crit, evade, healing, heal_taken and the other mods are points. Built 2026-11-13 from the hand-written forms in design/builds (harvested, conflicts resolved toward the rule text) plus new ones. Đạo Đồ Effects (source "Đạo Đồ", 2026-11-20; written by tools/design/dao_do_rework/content/tree_effects.py, which explains their fields): a build file names them in tree_effects. Extra fields: lines (plain stat lines, the closing numbers), count {of, cap} by a build count, fixed records (closings, never counted), pool_more, stack_alias, no_ward, only_tag, sheet_from, pending, engine_choice.

Ageless Pine.rule: Your Wood buff stacks never fall off during a fight. Closes: Fire resistance -25.

Alchemist's Heart.rule: The first pill you take in each fight counts twice. Closes: pill toxicity fades half as fast.
Alchemist's Heart.not_run: pills are not taken inside fights yet (Alchemy: pill use in combat has no host)

Armoury Count.rule: Your hits deal 4 % more for each equipped weapon-base artifact you carry. Closes: your wards are 15 % weaker.

Autumn Harvest.rule: Your crits refund the art's cost (3 firings a pulse). Closes: your linh lực regeneration is 0.

Backflow.rule: When you restore health with an art, you regain linh luc equal to 20 % of the health restored, at most 3 % of your maximum linh luc a pulse.
Backflow.approx: the 3 % a pulse cap is written as once a pulse; any heal counts, not only art heals

Bare Rack.rule: Your companion hits deal L5 +5 for each empty art slot, cap +20 (the basic-attack half is Pending). Closes (tree keystone): maximum health -15 %.
Bare Rack.engine_choice: companion hits skip the damage layers, so L5 +5 a slot is run as 5 % more damage a slot
Bare Rack.pending: the [basic] half, until Combat adopts the basic tag (#43; re-review EF 24)

Before Heaven.rule: Your damage and resistance grow with the number of elements your root owns: L5 +4 and resistance +40 per owned element, cap 5 elements.

Beneath Notice.rule: Against an enemy of a higher realm, your escape is likelier.
Beneath Notice.not_run: escape is not in the engine (deferred)

Blood Casting.rule: When your linh luc cannot pay for an art, you pay the shortfall in health, 1 for 1. Closes: healing taken -50 % for the fight.

Blood Drinker.rule: When your hit removes enemy health, you restore 6 % of what it dealt. Direct hits only, never ticks or trigger hits.

Bought Fate.rule: Once a fight, a roll that goes against you (a crit you take, an evade that fails, an escape that fails) goes your way instead. Closes: each flip burns 5 % of carried spirit stones.
Bought Fate.approx: the first crit taken is half undone by healing back 40 % of it (a crit's extra share at the default 1.5x is a third); stones are not in the sim

Boundless Sea.rule: Your linh lực pool doubles but no longer regenerates on its own. Closes: linh lực on hit gives nothing.

Brimming Cup.rule: Linh luc lost to a full pool fills your Cup: you gain 1 Water buff stack for 8 s for every 5 % of maximum linh luc lost, at most 2 stacks a pulse.
Brimming Cup.approx: each pulse's overflow counts on its own (a part under 5 % is lost, not carried)

Burning Ground.rule: Your Earth arts leave burning ground: the foe gains 2 Burn stacks, once per art firing.

Burning Lifespan.rule: Once a fight, when your health first falls to 30 % or below, you burn years for 5 s of fury: L5 +40 on all hits and art speed +30 for 5 s. Closes: the result reports 2 % of your realm's base lifespan in years lost, win or lose.
Burning Lifespan.pending: the lifespan the fight burns: the fight result does not report years yet (Realms / Time & Turn host)

Called Blow.rule: Your crit chance is counted on a visible meter, not rolled (Effects Formulas A). Closes: crit chance cap 0.50 -> 0.35.

Cold Feet.rule: Your escape art's first firing comes at cooldown_min.
Cold Feet.not_run: escape is not in the engine (deferred)

Dark of the Moon.rule: After you evade, your next hit crits (once per pulse).

Daybreak.rule: Your first Light hit each fight lays the foe bare (Exposed, 3 pulses).
Daybreak.engine_choice: a Light hit is a hit of an art tagged light (no art in the library carries it yet)

Debt of Stone.rule: When an art of yours is paid in health, you gain 1 Earth buff stack for 15 s for each 2 % of maximum health paid.

Deep Freeze.rule: Each time your Ice stacks on a target cross a multiple of 10, that target's art with the least time left is delayed by 1 s, once every 2 pulses. Closes: your arts cost 10 % more linh luc.
Deep Freeze.approx: fires on any Ice grant at 10 or more stacks, once every 2 pulses, rather than exactly at each multiple of 10

Drumbeat.rule: Every fourth art you fire in a fight is a guaranteed crit, and each such crit gives you 1 Thunder buff stack. Closes: your other arts have 8 less crit chance.
Drumbeat.approx: the Thunder stack lasts 8 s (the rule gives no length)

Earth Vein Tap.rule: While your own formation stands, linh lực regeneration +50 % increased; with none, none. Closes: no linh lực regeneration while no formation of yours stands.
Earth Vein Tap.not_run: formations do not stand inside fights yet (Formations host)

Earthen Armour.rule: After 3 s without being hit, your body shield refills 10 % a pulse. Closes: maximum linh lực -20 %.
Earthen Armour.engine_choice: 10 % of the starting bar a pulse, up to the starting bar

Ebb Tide.rule: The first time in a fight your linh lực falls below 30 %, restore 30 % of it. Closes: maximum linh lực -15 %.
Ebb Tide.engine_choice: checked after each art you fire and each hit you take

Echo.rule: When one of your arts lands a hit, it has a 25 % chance to strike again for free: c_trig 0.5, same tags, once per firing, inside the trigger budget.
Echo.approx: once per firing is written as once a pulse

Edge Returns the Breath.rule: Each crit with a Physical hit restores 0.8 % of your maximum linh luc. Closes: your non-Physical hits cannot crit.

Embers Feed the Hearth.rule: Each Burn tick you deal returns linh luc equal to 0.4 % of your maximum, at most 2 ticks a pulse.

Embers Never Die.rule: Your Burn on a target cannot be cleansed. A cleanse that would remove it removes the same number of your own Fire buff stacks instead. Closes: your own wards cannot cleanse you.
Embers Never Die.approx: the closing is not run (no ward in the sim cleanses its wearer)

Eruption.rule: Your costly Fire arts (cost share 10 % or more, the costly tag) deal L5 +15.

Ever-Burning Furnace.rule: Every Burn stack your hits apply returns +0.2 pp of maximum linh lực (10 stacks a pulse). Closes: your linh lực regeneration is 0.

Fan the Pyre.rule: Each Fire hit you land refreshes the duration of every Burn batch you have on the target. Closes: your direct Fire hits deal 8 % less (softened from 15 %, user decision 2026-11-13).

Final Clause.rule: Once a fight, as you go Down, your longest-cooldown art fires at no cost (ties to the earlier slot).

Fire Feeds Fire.rule: Your Burn stacks on the foe never fall off while you hit it at least once every 3 s. Closes: Water arts you slot deal 50 % less.
Fire Feeds Fire.engine_choice: each hit you land keeps every Burn batch of yours on the foe until at least 3 s later

Fire Lotus.rule: Your crits apply two more Burn stacks. Closes: crit damage -30 %.
Fire Lotus.engine_choice: the two stacks last 6 s, a typical Fire art's Burn batch

First Stand.rule: At the start of a fight, your body shield is already raised to 30 % of your maximum health. It does not refill.

First Thunder.rule: Your first art each fight fires at cooldown_min.

Flowing Water.rule: When you crit, your other arts' timers shorten by 0.5 s (3 firings a pulse). Closes (tree keystone): your art costs +40 %.

Frost Seal.rule: Your Ice stacks on the foe stop falling off once it holds 10 or more. Closes: Fire arts you slot deal 50 % less.

Glass Meridians.rule: Your arts run far faster (art speed +40), on a fragile body. Closes: maximum health -25 %; your body shields hold half.

Grave-Silk Shroud.rule: Corpse Rot is on the enemy from t = 0 without taking a slot. Closes: 15 % of maximum linh luc reserved for the fight.

Grinding Weight.rule: Your slow arts apply a stack of Slowed Time, once per art firing.

Gripping Root.rule: When your Physical Wood hit lands, the target's art with the least time left is delayed by 0.5 s, once per 2 s.

Heaven's Eye.rule: Your crits against an Exposed foe deal L5 +20 on that hit. Closes: your ward strength is 30 % lower.

Heaven's Verdict.rule: Your slow Thunder arts deal L5 +20 against a foe below half health.

Hidden Moon.rule: Your evade also counts as crit chance, point for point. Closes: your block and body shield count nothing; maximum health -20 %.

Hundred Refinements.rule: Half your artifact power also counts as attack. Closes: art speed -20 %.

Immovable Mountain.rule: Slowed Time and timer delays never land on you. Closes: art speed modifiers do nothing for you.

Iron Skin Renewed.rule: When you fire an art with a Physical part, your body shield regains 2 % of maximum health, once a pulse.

Keen Edge.rule: Your hits ignore the foe's block. Closes: your own block rating counts nothing.

Kindled Wound.rule: Your Fire parts deal more to a target bearing your Burn: L5 +15, scope fire.

Lamp-Lit Reading.rule: Each different status of yours on the target lowers its soul resistance by 3 points, to at most 5 statuses. Closes: your own soul resistance is 15 points lower.

Layered Earth.rule: Each hit you block raises your defence by 3 % until the fight ends, cap +30. Closes: your evade counts nothing.
Layered Earth.engine_choice: defence is ward strength, read live (ward_pct)

Lightning Drinker.rule: When a Lightning part hits you, 20 % of the damage it deals after resistance returns as linh luc.

Lingering Afterimage.rule: Your Blade counters (Afterimages, Coils) do not decay. Closes: your basic attack deals 30 % less.
Lingering Afterimage.approx: counter decay belongs to the build's own counters; a build with Blade counters writes its no-decay records itself (see design/builds/engine-v3/builds)

Marked Prey.rule: Your hits deal more for each different status of yours on the target: L5 +4 each, cap +16.

Metal Begets Water.rule: Each hit of a Metal art you land adds one Water buff stack to you. Closes: Wood arts you slot deal 50 % less.
Metal Begets Water.engine_choice: the stack lasts 10 s, a typical Water art's buff batch

Moss Ledger.rule: Poison stacks you lay cannot be cleansed for their first 4 s.

Mountain's Weight.rule: Your hits deal L5 +4 for each 10 % of maximum health you hold above the foe's, cap +32. Closes: art speed -20 %.

Nirvana.rule: Once per fight, the blow that would kill you leaves you at 30 % health instead. Closes: healing taken -30 %.

No Ward.rule: You can never use a ward, and your body hardens instead: body shield +25 %; after each pulse in which no hit reached your health, the body shield regains 2 % of maximum health. Closes: no ward of any kind.

Open Sky.rule: Your wards are 5 % stronger for each extra item slot you leave empty. Closes (tree keystone): artifact power -30 %.

Opening Cut.rule: When a Physical hit of yours crits, it applies one Bleed stack, once per hit.

Overheat.rule: Art speed that cooldown_min clips on an art becomes L5 on that art, point for point, cap +30. Closes (tree keystone): your art costs +35 %.

Owed Water.rule: When your linh luc falls to 20 % of maximum or below, you regain 15 % of your maximum linh luc over the next 5 s. Once every 20 s.
Owed Water.approx: checked once a pulse; +3 pp regeneration for 5 s (log-shaped like every regeneration bonus, so slightly under 15 %)

Pack Hunt.rule: Your companion's hits deal more to a target bearing any of your statuses: L5 +15, scope companion.

Paid in Advance.rule: Your talismans cost no linh luc when they fire. Closes: you may slot only talismans, wards and the escape art.
Paid in Advance.approx: cost reduction stops at the engine's 95 %; the slot rule is the build's to keep

Phantom Dodge.rule: Each basic attack of yours that lands counts as an evade for your arts' counters and held payloads, at most twice a pulse. Closes: you evade 10 pp less.

Phoenix Mend.rule: When you restore health with an art, the enemy gains 1 Burn stack for each 1 % of your maximum health restored, at most 6 a pulse, at your Burn's values.
Phoenix Mend.approx: any heal counts, not only art heals; Burn lasts 6 s

Planted Banner.rule: Your Earth parts deal 2 % more for every 4 Earth buff stacks you hold.

Plucked Time.rule: When one of your song arts lands a soul hit, the enemy's next ready art is delayed by 0.4 s, at most once a second. Closes: your arts that are neither soul nor song deal 15 % less.
Plucked Time.approx: the closing is not run (a filter cannot say 'neither soul nor song')

Reflection.rule: After you evade, your next art deals L5 +15, once per evade.

Returning Wave.rule: The first hit you take in each fight does you no harm and strikes the foe instead, at full damage. Closes: maximum health -15 %.
Returning Wave.engine_choice: the hit's damage before your defence strikes the foe through its defence

Rime Lock.rule: When your Ice stacks on a target reach 10, that target's art with the least time left is delayed by 1 s, once per 4 pulses per target.

Rising Tide.rule: While your linh lực is above half, your Water stacks count double. Closes: while it is below half, your Water stacks do nothing.
Rising Tide.engine_choice: your own Water buff stacks; the half reads linh lực without the stacks' own pool bonus

Sap Rises.rule: Each Wood buff stack you hold adds 1 % healing, up to 20 %.

Scatter Gale.rule: When you evade, you cleanse your own debuff stacks, at most 2 batches every 6 s.

Sea Already Deep.rule: You begin every fight with 8 Water buff stacks that last the whole fight. Closes: your arts cost 10 % more linh luc.

Seal of Full Payment.rule: Your arts and wards are paid in carried spirit stones.
Seal of Full Payment.not_run: carried spirit stones are not in the sim

Shattering Ward.rule: When one of your shields breaks, it bursts against the enemy: free Force hit, c_trig 0.6, 1 a pulse, 3 a fight.

Shield Pays the Blood.rule: Health that your arts would cost is paid from your body shield first, point for point; once the shield is gone, health pays again. Closes: your healing is 20 % weaker.

Spillover.rule: Your ticks also burn the target's linh luc, 25 % of the damage each deals after resistance.

Spirit Garden.rule: Herbs in your spirit fields ripen a season sooner. Closes: you can keep at most one spirit beast.
Spirit Garden.not_run: spirit fields and seasons are outside fights (Spirit Herbs & Spirit Fields host); its closing waits with it

Steady Breath.rule: While your linh luc is at 50 % or above, arts in this piece's scope deal more: L5 +12, scope set by the host.
Steady Breath.approx: unscoped here; a build whose host sets a scope writes its own record

Still Water.rule: Linh lực lost to a full pool restores health at half that amount. Closes (tree keystone): healing taken from every other source -50 %.

Stone Answers.rule: When your body shield or a ward stops damage, you strike back with a free Physical hit worth 25 % of the damage stopped, at most 6 % of your maximum health per pulse.
Stone Answers.not_run: a free hit sized by damage stopped needs a hit by amount, which the engine's free_hit (a coefficient) does not take

Strangling Vines.rule: Each time the foe reaches 5 Wood debuff stacks, it is Slowed Time for 1 s (once per 6 s). Closes: art speed -15 %.

Sun That Never Sets.rule: Each season you cultivate, you also gain 1 point of đạo tâm (+10 per realm). Closes: you can never conceal yourself; heart-demon resistance -30 %.
Sun That Never Sets.not_run: seasons and đạo tâm are outside fights (Cultivation / Time & Turn host); its closings wait with it

Sun and Rain.rule: Your health regeneration also restores linh lực, at half the amount (as a share of each pool). Closes: maximum linh lực -30 %.

Sword Chorus.rule: Your sword artifact arts deal 6 % more for each other equipped artifact that gives you a sword art, with no cap. Closes: your arts that are not sword arts deal 15 % less.
Sword Chorus.approx: applies to every sword art, not only artifact ones; the closing is not run (a filter cannot say 'not sword')

Ten Thousand Poisons.rule: Your Poison batches last until the fight ends. Closes: your hits deal 25 % less.

Ten Thousand Swords Return.rule: Your sword arts deal L5 +8 for each sword artifact you carry, cap +32. Closes: only arts with the sword tag may be slotted; your wards are 30 % weaker.

Thorns.rule: A blocked hit returns 30 % of the blocked amount to the attacker as physical damage, once per pulse.
Thorns.engine_choice: the returned damage meets the attacker's defence

Thousand Talismans.rule: The talismans you draw before a fight cost no stock for their first two uses. Closes: arts that are not talismans deal 30 % less.
Thousand Talismans.pending: talisman stock: the rule switches on with the Talismans GDD (the closing runs now)

Tide.rule: Your Water damage rises and falls in a 6-pulse cycle: L5 +0 to +20.

Toll Taker.rule: When the enemy pays art cost that your Ice stacks added, you restore linh luc equal to 10 % of that extra cost.

Unmaking Glass.rule: Each hit you land strips 1 buff stack from the target, from its largest pile, at most once a pulse; each stack stripped counts as a status you landed. Closes: your own buff stacks last 25 % shorter.

Unmoved Stance.rule: The art-speed and basic-speed penalties of your stances do not apply to you. Closes: your evade is 0 while a stance is on.

Unyielding Breath.rule: Once a fight, a blow that would put you Down leaves you at 1 health. Closes: maximum health -15 %.

Utmost Yang.rule: Your hits deal L5 +6 for each different base element among your slotted arts, cap +30. Closes: your wards are 30 % weaker.

Utmost Yin.rule: You resist 6 more for each different base element among your slotted arts, cap +30. Closes: your hits deal 20 % less.

Verdict Stands.rule: Your Thunder debuff stacks on a Slowed target cannot expire. Closes: Thunder stacks you lay on a foe that is not Slowed last 25 % shorter.
Verdict Stands.approx: held from the first status landed while Slowed; the closing is not run

Water Begets Wood.rule: Your Water buff stacks also count as Wood buff stacks. Closes: Earth arts you slot deal 50 % less.

Water Table.rule: You gain 30 % of the linh luc the enemy's drain wards pay against your hits. Closes: your linh luc never regenerates in fights.

Wheel in the Flag.rule: Your arts deal 5 % more for each element whose buff stacks you hold, up to five elements.

Whetstone Vow.rule: Art costs you pay in health are halved. Closes: you can never heal above 80 % of your maximum health.

Wildfire.rule: When one of your Burn batches runs out, half its stacks rekindle as a new batch for 2 pulses, once per batch.

Wind at Your Back.rule: When you evade, you gain 1 Wind buff stack for 4 s, at most 2 a pulse.

Wood Begets Fire.rule: Your Wood buff stacks also count as Fire buff stacks. Closes: Metal arts you slot deal 50 % less.
